jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Product Engineer to help us build better tools for legal research. You’ll work mainly on the backend, with a say in what we build and responsibility for taking it from an early idea to something customers use every day. That includes asking whether we’re solving the right problem, deciding what’s worth shipping first, and knowing when something needs more time.

**About Pandektes

**Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.

We're a team of 45+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We move fast, argue our positions, and ship. If your input is good, it gets implemented - often within hours, not sprints.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

**What We Value

**“How fast can we ship this?” comes up a lot at Pandektes. So does “we should take our time with this one.”

Knowing which question to ask is a big part of being an engineer here.

**Knowing when it’s good enough

**We like getting things into customers’ hands quickly. That means making trade-offs, questioning scope, and accepting when something is good enough for now. There’s usually another approach to explore or another prompt to try. At some point, you have to ship.

We use AI throughout our development process. AI code reviews, feature flags, and remote coding agents running end-to-end tests help us move quickly with confidence. Deciding what to build, what to check, and when it’s ready still takes judgment.

We value people who can find a smaller version worth shipping, explain the trade-offs, and follow through once customers start using it.

**Knowing when to slow down

**Some decisions deserve more time. Getting them right makes everything that follows easier. Getting them wrong means paying for the same mistake repeatedly.

Our default is to move quickly, so slowing down takes discipline. Sometimes it means pushing back when the rest of us want to get something out. We value someone who can explain why the extra work matters, challenge an approach, and help us decide where to spend our time.

You’ll have room to make those calls here, and teammates who will question them. We expect you to do the same for us.

**Mess Around. Find Out. Share What You Learned.

**We enjoy trying things before we know whether they’ll work. A new tool, a different way to use an agent, an idea that might turn out to be useless. Finding out is part of the work.

Once a month, we get together to demo our setups, show what we’re experimenting with, and share what we’ve learned. Sometimes we invite people from outside the team to show us how they work. Those sessions have changed how we build software.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We try to watch this video once a month to keep this value top of mind.

**The Experience You’ll Bring

**You’ve built and operated backend systems that real customers depend on. You can work through questions about data, APIs, performance, and security, and explain the consequences of your decisions.

Our stack includes TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, Postgres, and Prisma. We also work with OpenAI and Turbopuffer. Experience with these tools is useful; we’re especially interested in what you’ve built with them and the decisions you made along the way.

You enjoy working through a product problem while it’s still taking shape. You ask questions, share unfinished work, and help decide what’s worth building. You’re comfortable taking a feature from those early conversations through implementation, testing, and delivery.

**What we offer

**You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

We are usually office based but we all work from home time to time. You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work. Our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

Do you enjoy bringing out the best in people, keeping production on track and tackling the occasional curveball? Then you might be the Production Manager we're looking for.

At Aasted, we are looking for a Production Manager to lead our Combined Lines Solutions production department. You will take responsibility for a team of more than 40 employees and play an important role in creating a workplace where people thrive, work together and deliver high-quality solutions to customers around the world.

**About The Role

**As our new Production Manager, you will be responsible for the daily operations, performance and development of the Combined Lines Solutions production department.

Your most important responsibility will be leading and developing your team. Through clear communication, involvement and hands-on leadership, you will create the structure and motivation needed for employees to succeed.

You will report to the Head of Value Stream and work closely with 4 other competent Production Managers to ensure efficient production and timely deliveries.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Lead, motivate and develop a team of more than 40 production employees, with a strong focus on wellbeing, collaboration and performance.

• Ensure efficient daily production operations, including resource allocation, capacity planning and delivery performance.

• Work closely with the department's Planner to coordinate production schedules, priorities and resources.

• Monitor production performance, quality, costs and relevant KPIs, and take action when improvements are needed.

• Drive continuous improvements through structured processes, Lean principles and 5S initiatives.

• Ensure a safe working environment and compliance with quality, safety and environmental standards.

• Manage the department's production budget and contribute to efficient use of resources.

• Strengthen collaboration across production departments and other functions to ensure a smooth production flow.

• The role requires professional communication skills in both Danish and English

**About You

**We're looking for someone who knows their way around a production floor, enjoys working with people and understands that great results don't happen on their own.

You enjoy being close to the daily operations, supporting your employees and creating an environment where everyone understands their responsibilities and works towards common goals. You are comfortable making decisions, setting priorities and maintaining an overview, even when plans change.

You bring structure to a busy production environment and have the confidence to challenge existing ways of working when improvements are needed.

We imagine that you:

• Have several years of management experience from a technical or industrial production environment.

• You may have a technical education or have learned your way through years of hands-on experience. What matters most is that you know production and how to lead people.

• Have a proven ability to lead, motivate and develop production teams.

• Understand production planning, capacity management and operational performance.

• Have experience with continuous improvement, preferably Lean and 5S.

• Are comfortable working with production data, KPIs and ERP systems.

• Communicate clearly and build strong working relationships across different teams and departments.

Above all, you are a leader who takes an interest in people, leads by example and takes pride in seeing your team succeed.

**About Us

**You will become part of a well-established international company with a strong Danish heritage, where relationships are highly valued. In 2026, Aasted became part of the Italian Piovan Group, opening new perspectives and opportunities as part of a larger international group in the years to come.

At Aasted, our culture is characterized by motivated employees who take pride in their work, creating a strong sense of teamwork and commitment. We value open, honest and direct communication and believe in treating people with respect and integrity in everything we do.

We continuously strive to create an inclusive workplace with equal opportunities for development for all employees. We offer an attractive parental leave scheme, social events and a nice canteen operated by Meyers Kantine.

At Aasted, we prioritize a healthy working environment and are therefore a smoke-free workplace. This means that smoking is not permitted during working hours or anywhere on company premises.

**We look forward to hearing from you

**We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your CV and application as soon as possible.

If you have any questions or would simply like to learn more about the position, please feel free to contact Head of Value Stream, Combined Lines Solutions, Maria Osk Sigurdardottir, at mao@aasted.eu.

At Aasted, we strive to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome. We therefore encourage everyone to apply, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or political and cultural background.

You can read more about us and what we do here: AASTED | Welcome to our world

**_Aasted – a Danish pioneer

_**_Aasted has been a market leader in equipment and production lines for chocolate manufacturing worldwide for more than 100 years. Our customer portfolio includes both smaller local businesses and some of the world's largest global FMCG companies.

__We are on a continuous journey driven by curiosity, which has enabled us to rethink what was previously considered possible in chocolate production. We challenge the impossible and make it possible. We continuously introduce a wide range of groundbreaking and patented solutions for our customers, helping each of them achieve their unique vision.

_At Aasted, we are more than 550 people who, through passion, experience and expertise, challenge the status quo.

jobs.occupation: Manager of Automation & IT Project Management at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Manager of Automation & IT Project Management at Novo Nordisk Engineering

If you’re energised by leading people and complex technical projects and you thrive in a changing, multidisciplinary environment, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a Manager of AIT Project Management to join our AIT Project Management leadership team. As a team, we are working on some of the largest and most technically complex pharma projects in Denmark, using the latest technologies across Automation and IT.

Together with the AIT Project Management leadership team, you will lead and develop a department of 15 Project Managers delivering highly technical projects in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical environment. Your contribution will be important in ensuring high performance and employee wellbeing, while securing the right resources and competencies for our growing project portfolio.

You will work closely with Project Directors, customers, and Sales to support business development, follow up on new opportunities and ensure the right staffing across our projects. You will also contribute to creating a positive and engaging working environment across our wider team of more than 50 highly skilled Project Managers.

Our Project Managers bring experience across Process Automation, SCADA, PLC, IT/OT, PI, PAT, MES, and automated solutions. Project execution ranges from traditional PMP-based planning and execution to agile methodologies and the use of ADO, depending on the project area and customer requirements.

How you might spend your days

As a Manager of AIT Project Management, you’ll be:

• Leading, coaching, and developing a motivated team of Project Managers, ensuring high employee engagement and wellbeing

• Ensuring the right resources and competence mix are in place to support our growth strategy and project pipeline

• Working closely with Project Directors, customers, and Sales to support project delivery, business development, and new opportunities

• Strengthening Project Management processes within AIT and driving continuous improvements

• Supporting project execution and, when needed, taking on smaller assignments as a Project Manager

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• A supportive leader who listens, provides constructive feedback, and motivates others to succeed

• Committed to ongoing coaching and the wellbeing and development of your employees

• A team player who leads by example and collaborates effectively across different areas and levels

• A strong communicator with a positive, holistic, and analytical mindset

• Structured and effective in your work, with an open and engaging management style

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You hold a bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical discipline, or bring equivalent relevant experience

• You have at least four years of experience leading Project Managers and/or technical specialists

• You have a background as a Project Manager

• You have knowledge of the pharmaceutical industry

• You are fluent in written and spoken English and Danish

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 15th November 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Please contact VP of AIT Project Management Timme Traberg-Andersen +45 3079 9436.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

SENIOR MECHANICAL PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER

Join our product development team

Mechanical Product Development • Robust Design • Plastics • From Design To Production-ready Product

Location: Allerød, north of Copenhagen • Function: R&D / Product Development

Do you enjoy the engineering disciplines that turn a good mechanical design into a robust product design that works reliably in the real world?

Qufora is a growing, design-focused medical device company. We develop intuitive products that help people with chronic bowel disorders live a more fulfilled life.

We have a relatively small and flat organisation, which means short distances from idea to decision and from decision to action. You will be close to the products, the technical decisions and the people who make them—with the opportunity to influence both the engineering solutions and how we work.

The engineering role

This is a role for someone who enjoys the fundamentals of good mechanical engineering and knows how to combine them into robust design solutions. Understanding variation and sensitivity to design products that perform consistently despite real-world variation in components, materials, processes and use.

• Interface & mechanical design – create well-defined interfaces and mechanically sound solutions without unnecessary constraints or complexity.

• Tolerances & GPS/GD&T – translate functional needs into meaningful dimensions and tolerances, using tolerance stack-ups and statistical tolerancing where relevant.

• Mechanics & structural integrity – apply solid mechanics, engineering calculations and FEA where appropriate to understand loads, deformation, strength, fatigue and failure modes.

• Materials & plastics – select materials based on function, environment, manufacturing process and long-term product performance.

• DFM/DFA & injection moulding – develop designs that can be manufactured and assembled consistently and at the required quality, working closely with toolmakers, suppliers and Operations.

• Variation & statistical analysis – use data and statistical methods to understand variation, identify critical parameters and build robustness into the design.

You will not be placed in a narrow technical box. Depending on the challenge, you may move from CAD and tolerance analysis to material selection, supplier discussions, FEA, design reviews, verification results or solving a difficult mechanical problem in an existing product.

What you will do

You will take senior technical ownership of mechanical development activities, particularly in the later stages of product development.

You will:

• Develop and mature mechanical solutions from established concepts through detailed design, verification, design transfer and launch.

• Create high-quality 3D designs and clear, production-ready 2D drawings.

• Drive difficult mechanical issues to root cause and closure.

• Work hands-on with plastics, injection-moulded components, interfaces, tolerances, materials and robust design.

• Work closely with Operations, external manufacturers, suppliers and toolmakers to turn designs into stable, manufacturable products.

• Lead and coordinate mechanical engineering activities when several people or disciplines need to contribute.

• Help strengthen our mechanical engineering methods, standards and ways of working.

What we are looking for

You have a BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Product Development or a similar discipline and at least 8 years of experience in mechanical product development.

Ideally, you bring several of the following:

• Strong mechanical design fundamentals and engineering judgement.

• Experience with plastic product design and injection moulding.

• Advanced 3D CAD and 2D drawing skills, preferably SolidWorks.

• Strong knowledge of ISO GPS/GD&T, tolerance analysis and robust design.

• Experience with DFM/DFA, materials, mechanics and preferably FEA.

• Experience taking products from detailed development through verification and into production.

• The ability to structure complex technical work and drive issues to completion.

Experience from medical devices or another regulated industry is an advantage, but first and foremost, we are looking for a strong mechanical product developer.

Why Qufora?

At Qufora, you will work broadly across mechanical engineering disciplines and follow products through the development process rather than being limited to one narrow area. You will be close to the products, colleagues and decisions, with the opportunity to influence both engineering solutions and how we work. And because we develop medical devices, your engineering decisions ultimately matter to people who rely on our products every day.

Application

Please apply through LinkedIn. Applications will be reviewed, and interviews held on an ongoing basis.

We have an exciting opportunity for a seasoned Logistics Procurement Category Manager to join the Group Procurement function at Royal Unibrew.

Are you a passionate procurement and supply chain professional with expertise in Logistics and a demonstrated track record of positively influencing across internal and external ecosystems to unlock end to end value and efficiencies to fuel sustainable growth?

As Group Category Manager – Logistics, you will report to the CPO and lead the development and execution of the Group Logistics procurement strategy across road freight including line-haul and last mile distribution, ocean freight, warehousing and related logistics services including pallets. You will combine strategic category leadership with hands-on execution, working closely with local market organisations,

The role will be based at our HQ in Faxe, Denmark.

**Main Responsibilities

**Strategy Development:

• Define and execute a multi-year procurement category strategy for Logistics that balances local execution with strategic priorities to support the group’s overarching goals.

• Leverage a strong external radar and category expertise to identify, evaluate and act on emerging opportunities and risks, i.e. external supplier landscape, commodities, industry best practices, digitalisation and automation and EU legislative environment.

**Category And Supplier Relationship Management

**

• Optimise category management processes, elevate sourcing and contract management processes, and build best practices with the market teams and stakeholders. Increase utilisation of eSourcing and development of digital tools to support cost modelling, benchmarking, and contract management.

• Develop supplier collaboration platforms with key suppliers across the group to unlock operational efficiencies, process enhancements, digital innovation, and to accelerate sustainability and circularity initiatives.

**Value Delivery, Efficiency And Business Partnering

**

• Deliver cost savings, supply chain efficiencies and carbon reduction targets. Establish ways of working with stakeholders to measure relevant KPIs, track initiatives, manage risk and deliver multiyear productivity plans.

• Ensure early engagement and alignment with relevant stakeholders on business strategy to maintain a fit for purpose and efficient logistics network driving optimal cost to serve to fuel sustainable business growth.

• Provide category leadership and inputs into on strategic projects, integration, and network optimisation.

• Streamline processes and drive digitalisation agenda.

**Ideal Candidate

**

• Bachelor’s degree. Professional CIPS qualification or similar will be considered.

• Min. 8 years of relevant procurement experience in logistics categories in an international or matrixed organisation. Nordics and CPG industry experience is a plus.

• Comprehensive knowledge of procurement processes, ERP systems, procurement tools and network modelling, including a strong data analytics skillset and commodity management experience.

• Excellent communication, gravitas and influencing skills to build relationships with senior stakeholders internally and externally.

• Team player with a service-oriented mindset but is also not afraid to challenge the status quo or be the critical friend when required.

• Project and change management - track record for initiating and embedding change.

• Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands on execution.

• Energised by challenges, white spaces, and complexity.

• Enthusiastic, solution-oriented approach.

• Passion for developing and coaching teams.

**What Success Looks Like

**Success in this role means creating a Logistics procurement organisation that is recognised as a strategic business partner, delivering measurable value beyond price reduction.

The successful candidate will establish strong Group category governance while enabling local ownership, build strategic supplier partnerships, increase data and digital maturity, strengthen resilience and sustainability, and continuously identify opportunities to improve the total cost, service and efficiency of Royal Unibrew's logistics network.

At Royal Unibrew, you'll find the industry's most dedicated, energetic, and experienced colleagues. Together, we build the best framework for a job that precisely matches your everyday life and career aspirations.

Royal Unibrew produces, markets, sells, and distributes quality beverages. We are a consortium of more than 35 breweries and beverage producers from across Denmark, known especially for our traditional, locally-rooted brands such as Faxe Kondi, Egekilde, Royal Beer, Ceres, and Odense Pilsner, as well as partner brands like Pepsi MAX and Heineken.

Today, we are the second-largest beverage company in Denmark. Our journey began in 1856, and we still maintain a strong commercial focus, a clear growth strategy, and an ambitious sustainability strategy - both domestically and internationally.

You'll have over 1500 colleagues in Denmark and more than 2700 colleagues outside the country, including in Finland, Italy, France, Norway, Canada, the Netherlands, and the Baltic countries.

With us, you'll be part of challenging the boundaries of sustainable production and distribution. You'll help ensure a diverse range of beverages that bring people together - on the dance floor, during the third half, or over a meal - all while contributing to strengthening Danish sports, music, and community life.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager, EndoIntelligence Solutions, Global R&D
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Project Manager with a background in medical device development? Do you enjoy leading complex development projects and coordinating work across internal teams and external development partners? Then you may be the Project Manager we are looking for in EndoIntelligence Solutions within Global R&D.

In this role, you will lead a strategically important development project and work closely with a global and cross-functional team to ensure successful project execution from planning through delivery.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of in-person collaboration and focused individual work. That's why this role is based in Augsburg or Ballerup and follows a hybrid working model, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home.

**Key Responsibilities

**As Project Manager, you will:

• Lead a cross-functional development project through all phases of the product development process.

• Drive project planning, execution, follow-up, and reporting of scope, timeline, budget, risks, and key decisions.

• Coordinate activities across engineering disciplines and key stakeholders.

• Manage and maintain strong collaboration with external development partners and suppliers.

• Facilitate project governance activities, including Steering Committee reviews and decision-making forums.

• Ensure project documentation and deliverables are completed in accordance with Ambu's quality system and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Create transparency, alignment, and engagement across the project team and stakeholder landscape.

• Support the continuous improvement of project management practices and lessons learned.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experience can be gained in many ways, and we understand that the perfect candidate cannot be defined on paper. However, you are likely to succeed in this role if you:

• Hold a technical degree within engineering or a related field.

• Have experience leading the development of complex medical device hardware, including electronics, mechanics, embedded systems, and integration across disciplines.

• Have worked closely with external development partners and suppliers and understand how to manage outsourced development activities, technical deliverables, timelines, and risks.

• Have experience working with internal and external development teams across different regions, including Asian and European countries, and bring the cultural awareness needed to adapt ways of working and build effective collaboration across cultures.

• Are comfortable navigating a complex stakeholder environment and driving alignment across functions.

• Bring a structured and proactive approach to project execution and risk management.

• Have strong communication and leadership skills and enjoy working with international teams.

• Are fluent in written and spoken English.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**At Ambu, you will become part of an international organization with ambitious growth plans and a strong innovation agenda. We work in cross-functional teams and value collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement. You will have the opportunity to contribute to innovative healthcare solutions while developing your professional and personal capabilities in a dynamic environment.

Apply directly through our job portal. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**Ready to shape the marketing experience for one of the most exciting categories in Nordic e-commerce?

We are looking for a Marketing Manager for a maternity cover of approximately 13 months to drive the customer-facing journey and category performance across our Kids department. From everyday essentials to seasonal collections, footwear and accessories, you will bring the category to life through engaging campaigns, inspiring content and a seamless shopping experience across our channels.

This is your chance to join a passionate, fast-paced team where creativity meets commercial strategy, and where your work makes a real impact on how customers discover and shop Kids at Boozt.

**What You Will Do

**As our Marketing Manager for the kids category, you will play a key role in planning and executing marketing activities across onsite, CRM and campaign touchpoints, ensuring that the category stays relevant, engaging and commercially strong.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• 
Develop and execute quarterly and yearly Kids marketing plans, aligned with commercial priorities and seasonal initiatives.

• 
Own the Kids front page and key landing pages, ensuring a strong and engaging digital shopping experience.

• 
Monitor traffic, engagement and category KPIs, using performance insights to evaluate results and optimize activities.

• 
Coordinate with Buying & Merchandising (B&M) on trading plans, product launches and brand exposure.

• 
Collaborate with CRM to develop engaging, high-performing email campaigns that support category priorities.

• 
Brief and coordinate visuals with our Content and Art teams for campaigns and seasonal initiatives, ensuring a consistent experience across onsite, landing pages and newsletters.

**YOUR PROFILE

**We are looking for someone who combines a creative mindset with a strong commercial understanding and knows how to turn customer insights and category trends into engaging marketing activities.

**We Imagine That You Bring

**

• 
At least 3 years of e-commerce marketing experience, preferably within fashion, kidswear or retail

• 
Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities and deadlines

• 
A collaborative mindset and experience working across creative, commercial and technical teams

• 
Strong analytical skills and experience using tools such as Google Analytics and Qlik Sense

• 
An understanding of customer behaviour, seasonal trends and what drives performance in an online retail environment

• 
Fluency in English, our company language

**WHY BOOZT?

**At Boozt, creativity and commercial thinking go hand in hand. You will join a fast-paced, dynamic e-commerce business where you can take ownership, bring ideas to life and make a real impact. Working closely with colleagues across teams, you will gain valuable experience, build relationships and get to know a large organization with many different areas of expertise. And who knows where your Boozt journey might take you next?

**Apply today – we’re excited to learn more about you!

**_Only applications submitted in English will be considered.

_Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Denmark at the time of employment. Please note that this position does not include visa sponsorship or relocation support.

We review applications on an ongoing basis. You can read more about the process under **Recruitment.

****BOOZT PERKS

**

• 
Great personal and internal career development opportunities

• 
A culture built on our values of trust, freedom, and responsibility

• 
Driven and passionate international colleagues

• 
A generous employee discount

• 
Healthy and delicious breakfast and lunch, top-quality coffee, and fresh fruit available all day

• 
In-house gym, onsite masseuse, and medical doctor

• 
An amazing HQ in central Copenhagen – the iconic, energy-efficient Krystallen building, recognized for its architectural design and sustainability. Enjoy breathtaking city views and much more!

We are seeking a Financial Controller to own the integrity of Tekla’s financial reporting across the group. The role combines technical control work, balance sheet reconciliations, consolidation and eliminations, with ownership of a growing set of tax and trade compliance obligations spanning packaging tax, EU and global VAT and customs duties.

The Financial Controller is responsible both for meeting these obligations accurately and on time, and for building the processes, controls and automation that make them repeatable as the business scales. The role sits within an AI-first function focused on operational excellence, so we are looking for someone with a strong digital mindset and a proactive approach to using AI and automation tools to enhance reporting and improve efficiency.

This is a hands-on role, instrumental in ensuring financial accuracy and supporting Tekla's profitability and growth objectives. Reporting to the Finance Director and working closely with the Accounting Manager, the Financial Controller will also contribute to a range of ad hoc financial projects and initiatives across the function.

This is a full-time position based in our open-plan, curated office in Copenhagen.

Key responsibilities of the role include, but are not limited to:

Financial Controlling & Reporting

• Design, implement and manage the group's balance sheet reconciliations, including building standardised templates and processes across multiple entities

• Prepare the monthly and year-end group consolidation, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation and consolidated reporting packs

• Ensure the general ledger is supported by complete, reviewed and documented reconciliations in every period. While taking a hands-on approach to booking journals and ad hoc analysis

Tax & Trade Compliance

• Own end-to-end packaging tax obligations, including data capture, calculation and filing

• Perform compliance reviews over packaging tax, taking a proactive approach as Tekla's global footprint grows

• Analyse customs and import duties, covering tariff classification, country of origin, preferential rates and duty paid versus duty due, and identify recovery and savings opportunities.

Financial Analysis & Performance

• Monitor cash flow, working capital, and financial performance metrics

• Perform variance and accuracy analyses to validate forecasts, budgets, and data integrity, encouraging transparency and accountability

• Investigate material variances and implement process improvements that enhance forecasting precision and analytical rigour

• Provide insightful financial analysis to support business planning, cost efficiencies and strategic priorities

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business objectives

Process Improvement & Automation

• Drive continuous improvement by leveraging AI and emerging technologies to enhance financial processes, systems, and reporting tools

• Support the automation programme within the accounting team, including Intrastat and VAT reporting

• Review and implement continual improvements in Business Central, including VAT code configuration, VAT statements and financial reports

• Strengthen documentation and controls across all owned processes so they are auditable and transferable

We'd love to hear from you if you are / have:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field

• Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting standards and tax regulations

• Demonstrable experience of group consolidation and intercompany eliminations in a multi-entity, multi-currency environment

• Strong working knowledge of global VAT and sales tax concepts

• Exposure to packaging tax regimes is an advantage

• Experience designing and operating a balance sheet reconciliation control framework

• Confident ERP user, ideally Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

• Demonstrable experience using AI tools such as Claude to optimise and automate financial processes and reporting, for example building reporting dashboards, automating reconciliation and compliance workflows, or analysing large transactional data sets

• Advanced Excel skills and comfort working with large transactional data sets

• Experience from a high-growth business within fashion, textiles or luxury consumer goods is an advantage

• An entrepreneurial mindset with strong interpersonal skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis, with the aim of the successful candidate joining us as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: HR Business Partner, Strategic Marketing and International Sales
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced HR Business Partner who thrives in a dynamic international environment? Do you enjoy partnering with senior leaders, translating business priorities into people strategies, and driving organisational effectiveness through strong HR partnering? And are you motivated by supporting commercial organisations where leadership, talent and culture play a critical role in business success? Then you might be our new HR Business Partner for Strategic Marketing and International Sales at Demant Diagnostics.

Driving people and business success across Strategic Marketing and International Sales

As HR Business Partner for Strategic Marketing and International Sales, you will act as a trusted advisor to leaders and leadership teams, helping translate strategy into practical people and organisational solutions. You will support two business functions, each led by its own Vice President and operating with different priorities, organisational structures and ways of working.

In this role, you will partner closely with leaders to strengthen organisational effectiveness, leadership capability, employee engagement and business performance. You will be responsible for ensuring that people priorities are closely aligned with business goals while supporting the execution of the broader Diagnostics and global Demant people agenda.

Meet your new team and manager

The Diagnostics HR team acts as a close partner to leaders and the organisation, enabling strong performance, development and engagement across our global Diagnostics business. We work at the intersection of people, business and organisational development, ensuring that HR initiatives create value for both leaders and employees.

Our team values trust, development and continuous improvement. We combine strategic HR partnering with pragmatic execution and take pride in delivering professional, high-quality support across a diverse and international organisation.

The position is reporting to Kirsten Schmidt, Senior Director Diagnostics HR, and is based at the Demant Diagnostics Headquarters in Smørum, Copenhagen. We offer flexibility to work from home when business needs and tasks allow.

Global HR partnering supporting a growing business area

The HR Business Partner will play a key role in supporting leaders through organisational changes, helping navigate complexity, manage stakeholder expectations and create sustainable business solutions.

You will collaborate with HR colleagues and business stakeholders across functions, countries and organisational levels to ensure consistent and effective implementation of HR initiatives.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Partner closely with the Vice Presidents and leadership teams within Strategic Marketing and International Sales

• Act as a trusted advisor and sparring partner on leadership, organisational and people-related matters

• Coach and challenge leaders to strengthen leadership effectiveness and team performance

• Drive and support organisational development, capability building and change initiatives

• Drive and facilitate initiatives to ensure alignment between business priorities and global HR processes.

• Lead talent and succession discussions, supporting the identification, development and retention of key capabilities

• Use people insights and workforce data to support informed decision-making and organisational planning

In addition, you will support organisational reviews, workforce planning and employee engagement initiatives while contributing to a positive, inclusive and high-performing culture.

**Your qualifications & experience

**

We imagine that you will bring a combination of:

• Solid experience as an HR Business Partner supporting leaders and commercial organisations in a complex business environment

• Relevant degree within human resources, business administration, organisational psychology or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

• Proven experience advising and influencing leaders on organisational, talent and people matters

• Experience driving organisational change, leadership development and talent management initiatives

• Strong understanding of core HR disciplines and employment practices

• Experience working in an international and matrix-based organisation

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken

• Experience supporting senior leaders or executives

Bringing solid business acumen, sound judgement and a collaborative approach to all your stakeholders will provide you with a great foundation for this role. Furthermore, you are comfortable balancing strategic priorities with operational execution and have the confidence to challenge constructively while building trusted relationships across the organisation.

Why join us?

This is an opportunity to join a global organisation where people, leadership and business performance are closely connected. You will work with experienced leaders, influence strategic people agendas and contribute to shaping the future organisation across Strategic Marketing and International Sales.

Ready to join Demant Diagnostic’s HR team?

Then send your application and CV in English as soon as possible but no later than 8th of November. Please note we only accept application via our application system.

1st interviews will be conducted on the 17th of November

We aim to conduct 2nd interviews on the 24th of November

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

About Demant Diagnostics

Demant’s diagnostics business is a trusted diagnostic solutions provider in the field of hearing and balance assessment. This group of international companies develops, manufactures, and markets a wide variety of technological solutions globally, delivering instruments, software, training, and services that support the entire diagnostic journey – from early screening to advanced clinical assessment and balance treatment. Our portfolio includes well-known brands such as Maico, Interacoustics, Amplivox, GSI Grason-Stadler, MedRx, Audioscan, and Inventis.

Our products are sold in more than 100 countries through an extensive network of sales companies and distributors.

For more information, please visit: www.demant.com.

Would you like to lead the development of cutting-edge audiology that improves life for millions of people with hearing loss worldwide?

In this role, you will work at the heart of Demant’s innovation, leading the group that creates the world-leading audiological technology used across Demant hearing aids.

The Role

As Director, you will lead the leaders and teams that make up the Audio group—an organization of 75 highly skilled experts. Through your leadership team, you will be accountable for strengthening R&D delivery and ensuring that the organization has the skills, culture, capacity, structure, and ways of working required to succeed.

You will set direction, develop leaders, and enable teams to perform at their best. Building on a strong existing organization and guided by the company strategy, you will prepare the organization for the future.

Welcome to Audiological Solutions

You will join a global R&D organization of more than 1,000 engineers and specialists across electronics, mechanics, software, acoustics, AI, and audiology—all working to improve hearing healthcare.

The Audio group is part of the Audiological Solutions department, one of the cornerstones of the Device Software area. We believe in collaboration, curiosity, openness, and diverse thinking. Your leadership will shape how we deliver, learn, and grow.

Your Responsibilities

Reporting to the Senior Director of Audiological Solutions, you will:

• Lead and develop an organization of 75 developers and leaders responsible for one of Demant’s core deliveries: world-leading audiology for Demant hearing solutions.

• Lead and develop leaders, providing clear direction and an inclusive environment where people can contribute and grow.

• Be accountable for R&D delivery through your leadership team and organization.

• Partner with SAFe ART leadership to create transparency, remove systemic barriers, and deliver value.

• Translate company strategy into clear priorities and action.

• Build the skills and competencies, and allocate the capacity, needed to deliver the roadmap and secure long-term success—with innovation as a key priority.

• Build a culture rooted in innovation, trust, collaboration, and the ambition to lead audiology.

• Lead organizational design, including recruitment, performance, development, engagement, and wellbeing.

• Improve workflows and strengthen learning and collaboration across organizational boundaries.

About You

You are an experienced people leader with a strong record of helping teams perform and grow. You have likely led leaders, either directly or indirectly. You create clarity, share accountability, and empower others to make decisions.

You communicate clearly, listen well, and build alignment across functions and organizational levels. You approach complex problems with curiosity and sound judgment, and you work effectively in a matrix organization.

You understand R&D delivery and can connect people, skills, capacity, quality, and ways of working with product and technology roadmaps. Familiarity with Lean-Agile leadership and SAFe is valuable, as is the ability to combine a strategic perspective with practical delivery insight.

You bring considerable leadership experience, hold a higher technical education, and have preferably experience within audiology or related areas. Fluency in English is required.

Interested?

To learn more about the role, contact Ole Fogh Olsen, Senior Director of Audiological Solutions, at oleo@demant.com.

Apply by November 1st 2026 through our online recruitment system.

We look forward to hearing from you.

_At Demant, we value diversity, equity, and inclusion (DE&I), and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

_Demant is a world leading hearing healthcare and technology group built on a heritage of care, health, and innovation since 1904. The Group offers innovative technologies, solutions, and expertise to enable people hear better. In every aspect, from hearing care, hearing aids and hearing implants to diagnostic equipment and services and audio solutions, Demant is active and engaged. Headquartered in Denmark, the Group employs more than 21,000 people globally and is present with solutions in 130 countries where we create life-changing hearing health and high-end audio and video solutions. William Demant Foundation holds the majority of shares in Demant A/S, which is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and among the 25 most traded stocks.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**About The Role

**Genmab is seeking a Project Manager CMC Product Lifecycle Management to

• join the CMC Life Cycle Management (LCM) Team and support our growing portfolio of commercial products globally.

The LCM team is responsible for managing the CMC lifecycle activities of Genmab’s commercial products and manufacturing oversight, ensuring supply continuity, regulatory compliance, and successful execution of post-approval activities throughout the product lifecycle. In this role, you’ll work closely with LCM Product Lead and colleagues across Commercial Supply Chain, MSAT, Regulatory CMC, Commercial QA and External Manufacturing to ensure seamless execution of lifecycle management activities.

The CMC Life Cycle Management Team is part of CMC Project & Portfolio Management (PPM) which also includes the Early-Stage Development, Late-stage Development and External Manufacturing teams. CMC Project & Portfolio Management resides within CMC Development and Manufacturing, based in Denmark.

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the continued growth of Genmab's commercial portfolio while working in a highly collaborative and cross-functional environment at the interface of development, manufacturing, supply, and regulatory affairs.

**Responsibilities

**

• Work alongside the LCM Lead to provide manufacturing oversight and execute lifecycle activities for an assigned manufacturing track (DS, BI, CI or DP) after commercial launch, supporting batch release and reliable supply. The LCM Lead retains overall product accountability.

• Lead operational governance with internal functions and partners/CMOs, aligning priorities, preparing decisions, tracking progress and actions, and providing input on CMO performance.

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders on daily operations to ensure manufacturing oversight (ie. Deviation management, change control, complaint handling, etc) , support batch release and supply, issues resolution/escalation and quality/regulatory compliance.

• Coordinate technical issue resolution and manage track risks with relevant experts, ensuring required assessments, documentation and mitigation actions, and escalating issues with proposed next steps.

• Drive manufacturing changes, projects and improvements within agreed scope, timelines and budgets.

• Support implementation of CMC commitments and Post-approval change management related to assigned product manufacturing track (i.e DS, BI, CI, DP) and support coordination of submission documentation preparation across stakeholders and CMOs/Partners.

• Support initiatives to optimize yield, reduce cost of goods, and enhance robustness of manufacturing and testing processes

• Help establish and improve LCM processes, governance, tools and ways of working, incorporating lessons learned.

**Requirements

**

• Master's degree in science or related technical discipline (e.g. engineering, biotech, pharmaceutical, biochemistry, biology) or equivalent experience;

• 4+ years of experience in biopharmaceutical industry, preferably within manufacturing operations, lifecycle, product management for commercial products.

• Experience in building relations and influencing multi-functional teams within multicultural organizations.

• Proven track record in CMC project management, manufacturing operations management or product management across development and commercialization activities.

• Experience managing and defining project coordination activities and tasks in a structured, regulated environment.

• Prior experience with commercial product lifecycle management and oversight of Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) is considered an advantage.

• Broad understanding of global cGMP requirements and regulatory expectations across major markets

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in English

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional and multicultural environments

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, balance competing demands, and deliver against project timelines

• Team player with the ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

• Result- and goal-oriented, committed to contributing to Genmab’s success

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK597.312,00---895.968,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

**A Snapshot of Your Day

**Join Siemens Energy as a Product Manager with a strong focus on Wind Power and SCADA systems, where you act as the key link between business needs and agile development teams. Ideally, you have knowledge from the energy sector - maybe you even have a hands-on understanding of how wind farm operators work and the daily challenges they face, translating this into scalable and maintainable digital solutions. You operate across both strategic and operational levels – shaping product direction while working closely with teams to ensure efficient delivery. Your soft skills are strong and you know how to navigate having many different stakeholders in a dynamic environment, as well as manage both upwards, sideways and downwards. You are the type of person that takes ownership, and with a pragmatic mindset, you balance innovation, cost awareness, and technical feasibility to deliver competitive solutions that create real business value.

**How You'll Make An Impact

**

• Act as Product Manager for OT software and SCADA-related solutions, owning prioritization and value delivery across agile teams

• Translate real-world wind farm operational challenges into product requirements, ensuring solutions are practical and customer-focused

• Balance strategic roadmap ownership with hands-on involvement in agile delivery teams

• Drive prioritization based on business value, cost efficiency, and technical feasibility

• Identify technology trends and partnerships that support scalable, maintainable, and competitive solutions

**What You Bring

**

• Master’s degree in software engineering or similar combined with strong experience in Wind Power SCADA systems and OT environments

• Hands-on understanding of wind farm operations and the challenges faced by operators and service organizations

• Proven experience working both strategically and operationally within Product Management or similar roles

• Strong business mindset with focus on cost efficiency, maintainability, and pragmatic decision-making

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across technical and business domains

**Who is Siemens Energy?

**At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With +100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemensenergy.com/employeevideo

**Our Commitment to Diversity

**Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

**Rewards/Benefits

**

• Become a part of our mission for sustainability: Clean energy for generations to come

• A global team of diverse colleagues who share passion for renewable energy

• Personal and professional development to grow internally within our organization

• Flexible working hours as well as home-office

• Attractive remuneration package (fixed/variable)

• Local benefits such as subsidized lunch and public transport tickets, employee discounts and much more

**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Climate Solutions, we engineer energy-efficient heating and cooling solutions that help our customers decarbonize while staying resilient and competitive. Our Controls and Thermal Management division combines heat exchanger expertise with technologies for refrigeration, cooling and air conditioning, serving customers across HVAC, refrigeration and industrial applications.

In this role, you’ll lead our European Sales team for Brazed, Gasketed and Welded Heat Exchangers and play a key role in accelerating growth across both existing customers and new markets.

Your impact? You’ll shape and execute our European sales strategy, strengthen how we go to market, and continue the transformation toward a modern, data-driven sales organization with customer experience at its core.

Working closely with regional and global stakeholders, you’ll combine commercial leadership, market insights and strong customer engagement to turn opportunities into sustainable business growth.

We would prefer you to be located close to one of our main hubs in Kolding, Denmark, Kamnik, Slovenia, or Hamburg, Germany. Remote work may be considered for the right candidate, and we are open to supporting relocation.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Lead, develop and empower a European team of technical sales engineers and business developers to deliver sustainable sales growth.

• Shape and execute sales plans based on market insights, customer buying behavior and business priorities, working closely with regional and global stakeholders.

• Develop existing accounts and turn new leads, markets and customer opportunities into business growth.

• Build strong customer relationships through regular market engagement, identifying customer needs and demonstrating the value of our products and solutions.

• Drive a disciplined, data-driven sales approach through consistent use of CRM, forecasting and sales processes to support agile decision-making.

**What We're Looking For

**

• A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or equivalent knowledge and experience, combined with significant experience in sales, engineering or business development.

• Strong commercial and strategic capabilities, with the ability to analyze markets, competitors and opportunities and translate insights into effective business strategies.

• Strong negotiation, communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage customers, partners and diverse internal stakeholders.

• Knowledge of HVAC and/or industrial applications and markets, supported by solid analytical capabilities.

• A flexible and resourceful approach to changing market conditions, with the ability to navigate challenges and identify opportunities for growth.

The role requires approximately 20–40% travel, primarily within Europe.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about. We think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

Design the services that keep Defence Forces mission-ready. As a Service Designer, you will shape and sharpen the service offerings that help Defence organisations turn complex C4I capabilities into sustained operational readiness.

The job

You will build on and further develop our existing service offerings across pre-sales, system design, deployment, training, testing and operations. Through service design, systems thinking and deep user understanding, you will strengthen how we package, deliver and support complex C4I capabilities – enabling customers to maintain and enhance their operational readiness.

Your key responsibilities:

• Building on existing service definitions and best practices by analysing customer organisations, operational contexts and delivery experiences to identify improvement opportunities

• Extending and refining the service catalogue by translating input from Sales, service delivery teams and customers into standardized service offerings.

• Improving service blueprints, delivery models and customer journeys with a focus on operational fit, role clarity and predictable outcomes

• Facilitating structured workshops with delivery teams and key stakeholders to align and validate service content

• Strengthening standardised service packages to ensure consistent, repeatable delivery across customers and constellations.

Success in this role means customers move smoothly from initial engagement to effective operational use, are fully prepared to operate our solutions, and sustain their operational capability over time. Your work directly enables Defence organisations to deploy and sustain critical C4I capabilities with confidence.

Joining the team

You'll join our Defence Service Development team in Aarhus, working to continually strengthen the services behind our customers' everyday-ready C4I capabilities. The team brings together service design, military domain knowledge, solution architecture, portfolio management and business analytics. You'll work with strategic projects where an operational mindset is needed, evolving service definitions and delivery models to keep them relevant and effective. You'll report to Marie Lunde Jørgensen, Manager Defence Service Development and collaborate closely with stakeholders across our departments worldwide.

Your qualifications

You hold a relevant master’s degree – ideally in Service System Design, Strategy, Technology-Based Business Development or a similar field – and bring:

• Preferably experience in service design or service development for complex digital solutions, including creating new services and maturing existing ones to support operational delivery

• Experience with refining service definitions and delivery models for complex technical and organisational environments, with a focus on clarity, consistency and reduced operational risk

• Sound knowledge of service design methodologies, such as user journey mapping, service blueprinting and pain-point analysis

• Strong English communication skills, spoken and written, with an independent and structured approach to complex challenges

• Willingness to travel 10-20 days a month

It would also be an advantage if you bring:

• Experience with large-scale enterprise or defence solutions and established delivery organisations

jobs.occupation: BIOLOGIST - DHI MUSE AND AVIAN ECOLOGY
jobs.description:
Do you want to lead the ecological interpretation of complex offshore bird-monitoring projects? Can you turn radar, video, acoustic and environmental data into scientifically defensible conclusions for clients and regulators? Join DHI and take scientific ownership of projects at the intersection of avian ecology, technology and offshore wind.

Responsibilities and challenges

We are looking for a Biologist to support the scientific delivery of DHI MUSE and avian ecology projects. You will contribute to biological reviews, ecological analyses, reporting, and project coordination, working with experienced biologists, data scientists, instrumentation specialists and project managers. You will take increasing ownership of routine project-level scientific tasks, with guidance from senior colleagues and the Scientific Lead.

Your main responsibilities and challenges will include:

• Prepare, organise and analyse radar, video, acoustic, weather and system-status data needed for scientific deliverables.

• Contribute to ecological analyses of flight trajectories, bird flux, species distribution, phenology, avoidance behaviour and collision risk.

• Work with data scientists and analysts to review results and interpret them in their ecological context.

• Draft report sections, technical notes, presentations, figures, tables and responses to review comments.

• Document assumptions, uncertainty, limitations and other performance aspects clearly and consistently.

• Participate in project meetings and support communication with clients, suppliers, subcontractors and other DHI teams.

• Follow approved methods and quality procedures, and escalate unsupported conclusions or non-standard methods to senior colleagues.

Qualifications and personal skills

We are looking for a colleague with the following qualifications:

Required:

• Master's degree in biology, ecology, ornithology or a closely related discipline, equivalent relevant qualifications or other proven merits and references in ornithology.

• A strong foundation in avian ecology, species identification, animal behaviour, migration ecology or environmental monitoring.

• Ability to analyse scientific information and communicate findings clearly in writing and orally.

• Careful and consistent approach to biological classification, quality assurance and documentation.

• Good data-handling skills and willingness to work with radar, video, acoustic and environmental datasets.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Ability to collaborate across biological, analytical, technical and project-management disciplines.

• Ability to use AI to speed up delivery without loss of quality.

Desirable:

• Relevant professional, internship, thesis or research experience in bird monitoring, ecological consultancy or offshore wind.

• Experience reviewing wildlife video or acoustic recordings, identifying birds, or working with behavioural annotations.

• Experience in R, Python or other tools used for data analysis.

• Knowledge of environmental impact assessment, collision-risk modelling or remote-sensing methods.

Personal qualities:

• Curious, methodical and keen to learn.

• Self-motivated and comfortable asking for guidance when needed.

• Strong attention to detail and scientific integrity.

• Collaborative, service-minded and able to communicate with colleagues from different disciplines.

We offer

To work at DHI means being part of an organisation that addresses complex challenges in water and the environment. We will offer you:

• A role where ecological science is applied directly to offshore wind and environmental decision-making.

• Collaboration with biologists, data scientists, analysts, instrumentation specialists and project managers.

• Professional and personal development, with room to grow your scientific and client-facing responsibilities.

• Flexible working opportunities.

• A diverse, international network of highly skilled colleagues.

• The opportunity to contribute to the continued development of DHI MUSE and avian ecology services.

About DHI and DHI MUSE

DHI is a global and independent company dedicated to working on challenges within the fields of water and environment and sustainability. Within these fields, we provide a wide range of advisory, digital advisory, research and water governance services as well as providing leading edge MIKE and MUSE technologies and products to the market. At DHI, we are constantly looking for passionate and talented people who are eager to join our team.

DHI MUSE specifically is dedicated to managing the interplay between avian fauna and offshore wind energy. The product and associated work ultimately aim to automate bird monitoring, and as an add-on do curtailment of specific turbines when there is a risk of collision.

By joining DHI, you will not only become part of a dynamic and collaborative global team of experts; you will be empowered to innovate, engage and grow in your area of expertise. DHI is committed to disseminate our knowledge effectively and across our worldwide network of offices.

Office location

• The position is based at DHI's office in Hørsholm, Denmark, with flexible working opportunities in accordance with DHI policy.

How to apply

• Please submit your application and CV via the relevant job posting on DHI Careers.

• Application deadline: 2026-11-10.

• For further information, please contact Måns Karlsson, Scientific Lead, moka@dhigroup.com, +45 4516 9146.

We are seeking a Financial Controller to own the integrity of Tekla’s financial reporting across the group. The role combines technical control work, balance sheet reconciliations, consolidation and eliminations, with ownership of a growing set of tax and trade compliance obligations spanning packaging tax, EU and global VAT and customs duties.

The Financial Controller is responsible both for meeting these obligations accurately and on time, and for building the processes, controls and automation that make them repeatable as the business scales. The role sits within an AI-first function focused on operational excellence, so we are looking for someone with a strong digital mindset and a proactive approach to using AI and automation tools to enhance reporting and improve efficiency.

This is a hands-on role, instrumental in ensuring financial accuracy and supporting Tekla's profitability and growth objectives. Reporting to the Finance Director and working closely with the Accounting Manager, the Financial Controller will also contribute to a range of ad hoc financial projects and initiatives across the function.

This is a full-time position based in our open-plan, curated office in Copenhagen.

Key responsibilities of the role include, but are not limited to:

Financial Controlling & Reporting

• Design, implement and manage the group's balance sheet reconciliations, including building standardised templates and processes across multiple entities

• Prepare the monthly and year-end group consolidation, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation and consolidated reporting packs

• Ensure the general ledger is supported by complete, reviewed and documented reconciliations in every period. While taking a hands-on approach to booking journals and ad hoc analysis

Tax & Trade Compliance

• Own end-to-end packaging tax obligations, including data capture, calculation and filing

• Perform compliance reviews over packaging tax, taking a proactive approach as Tekla's global footprint grows

• Analyse customs and import duties, covering tariff classification, country of origin, preferential rates and duty paid versus duty due, and identify recovery and savings opportunities.

Financial Analysis & Performance

• Monitor cash flow, working capital, and financial performance metrics

• Perform variance and accuracy analyses to validate forecasts, budgets, and data integrity, encouraging transparency and accountability

• Investigate material variances and implement process improvements that enhance forecasting precision and analytical rigour

• Provide insightful financial analysis to support business planning, cost efficiencies and strategic priorities

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business objectives

Process Improvement & Automation

• Drive continuous improvement by leveraging AI and emerging technologies to enhance financial processes, systems, and reporting tools

• Support the automation programme within the accounting team, including Intrastat and VAT reporting

• Review and implement continual improvements in Business Central, including VAT code configuration, VAT statements and financial reports

• Strengthen documentation and controls across all owned processes so they are auditable and transferable

We'd love to hear from you if you are / have:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field

• Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting standards and tax regulations

• Demonstrable experience of group consolidation and intercompany eliminations in a multi-entity, multi-currency environment

• Strong working knowledge of global VAT and sales tax concepts

• Exposure to packaging tax regimes is an advantage

• Experience designing and operating a balance sheet reconciliation control framework

• Confident ERP user, ideally Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

• Demonstrable experience using AI tools such as Claude to optimise and automate financial processes and reporting, for example building reporting dashboards, automating reconciliation and compliance workflows, or analysing large transactional data sets

• Advanced Excel skills and comfort working with large transactional data sets

• Experience from a high-growth business within fashion, textiles or luxury consumer goods is an advantage

• An entrepreneurial mindset with strong interpersonal skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis, with the aim of the successful candidate joining us as soon as possible.
